premises.text: Day-to-day language barriers are poorly served by machine translation alone
premises.evidence_span: there must be a better way than machine translation

premises.text: Babelverse crowdsources real-time human interpreters globally
premises.evidence_span: it's crowdsourcing of real-time human interpreters all around the globe

premises.text: Product delivers live real-time video and conference interpretation
premises.evidence_span: what we have right now is a product for live video, live real-time video, and conferences

premises.text: Interpreter profiles capture languages, dialects, accents, availability, and domain expertise
premises.evidence_span: we collect the dialects and the accents too

premises.text: Hybrid model mixes professional interpreters with crowdsourced talent trained and rated up a ladder
premises.evidence_span: this is a hybrid crowdsource kind of solution. So we have professionals

premises.text: Network aims to cover nearly every spoken language, not only major pairs
premises.evidence_span: There are nearly 7,000 active spoken languages in the world, and we want to cover every single one of those

value.text: People get real-time human interpretation matched to language, dialect, and expertise
value.evidence_span: you get somebody in your dialect, in your accent, in your language, which is really important

secondary_value.text: Long-run vision of speaking any language anywhere without a de facto lingua franca
secondary_value.evidence_span: you can travel anywhere in the world and be able to speak with anybody regardless of what language they speak

causal_links.evidence_span: there must be a better way than machine translation
crowdsourcing of real-time human interpreters all around the globe
